about.text: Crafting timeless luxury with passion, precision, and purpose since 2010

Founded in the heart of Paris, {brand} began as a vision to redefine luxury cosmetics and fragrances. Our journey started with a simple belief: true luxury lies in exceptional quality, sustainable practices, and unforgettable experiences.
Today, we continue to honor our heritage while innovating for the future, creating products that celebrate individuality and timeless beauty.
Every product is meticulously crafted by master perfumers and cosmetic scientists who share our commitment to perfection.
We source ethically and sustainably, ensuring our luxury doesn't compromise the wellbeing of our planet or communities.
We build genuine relationships with our customers, understanding that luxury is as much about experience as it is about product.
We blend time-honored techniques with cutting-edge technology to create products that are both classic and contemporary.
Founded in Paris by Isabella Moreau, {brand} launched with our first fragrance collection, inspired by the gardens of Versailles.
We expanded our offerings to include a luxury cosmetics line, starting with our signature Velvet Noir lipstick collection.
Implemented our comprehensive sustainability program, achieving carbon neutrality and 100% recyclable packaging.
Received the prestigious Luxury Beauty Award for Innovation and Sustainability, marking our arrival on the global stage.
Launched our enhanced digital experience, bringing the {brand} atelier to customers worldwide through virtual consultations.
Fifth-generation perfumer with a Master's in Cosmetic Science from the University of Paris. Isabella brings over 20 years of experience in luxury fragrance development.
Trained in Grasse, France, Alexander has created award-winning fragrances for over 15 years. His expertise lies in sustainable scent extraction techniques.
Former lead chemist at a premier Parisian cosmetic house, Sophie oversees product formulation, ensuring both luxury performance and clean ingredients.
100% of our packaging is recyclable or refillable, with innovative programs to reduce waste throughout our supply chain.
We partner with certified sustainable farms and cooperatives worldwide, ensuring fair wages and environmental stewardship.
All our facilities are powered by renewable energy, and we offset 100% of our carbon emissions through certified programs.
Our products are formulated without harmful chemicals, prioritizing natural, biodegradable ingredients whenever possible.
Experience the art of luxury beauty and become part of our exclusive community of discerning individuals.

contact.text: We're here to help you with any questions about our luxury products, orders, or collaborations
123 Rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris, France
What is your return and exchange policy?

We offer a 30-day return policy for all unused and unopened products in their original packaging. For exchanges, we provide free return shipping within 60 days of purchase. Personalized items and limited edition collections may have different return conditions.

Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days within the US and 10-14 business days internationally. Express shipping is available for 2-3 business days domestically and 5-7 business days internationally. All orders are processed within 1-2 business days.
Are your products cruelty-free and vegan?

Yes, all {brand} products are cruelty-free and never tested on animals. While most of our products are vegan, some may contain beeswax or honey-derived ingredients. Vegan options are clearly marked on product pages and packaging.

Yes, we ship to over 50 countries worldwide. International shipping costs and delivery times vary by destination. Customs duties and taxes may apply depending on your country's regulations and are the responsibility of the recipient.
How can I track my order?

Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking number via email. You can also track your order by logging into your account on our website. For international orders, tracking may be available through our shipping partners' websites.
Experience luxury at our flagship store in the heart of Paris, featuring our complete collection, personalized consultations, and exclusive in-store events.
Our Madison Avenue boutique offers a curated selection of our most exclusive collections, along with VIP shopping experiences and private consultations.
Located in Mayfair, our London boutique features bespoke fragrance blending services and exclusive UK collections not available elsewhere.
